note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Event (sql/14_dimension_event.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Events may be tracked outside RegTrack, so an empty result here says something about this database, not proof that nothing happened. 'Activity' uses the last 12 months; it is a live figure.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @WindowStart DATETIME = '{WindowStart}';
DECLARE @WindowEnd DATETIME = '{WindowEnd}';
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
DECLARE @DormancyMonths INT = 12;
-- Step 1. Locations this user may see (scope pairs, location axis only).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#branch') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #branch;
SELECT DISTINCT BranchID INTO #branch FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopePairs(@UserID, @CustomerID);
-- Step 2. Event instances at those locations that started inside the report period
--         (EventInstance.StartDate; location live and active; nothing deleted).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ei') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ei;
SELECT ei.ID AS EventInstanceID, ei.EventID, ei.CustomerBranchID AS BranchID, ei.StartDate INTO #ei
FROM EventInstance ei JOIN CustomerBranch cb ON cb.ID = ei.CustomerBranchID JOIN #branch b ON b.BranchID = ei.CustomerBranchID
WHERE ei.IsDeleted = 0 AND cb.IsDeleted = 0 AND cb.Status = 1 AND cb.CustomerID = @CustomerID
AND ei.StartDate >= @WindowStart AND ei.StartDate < @WindowEnd;
-- Step 3. Event instances that actually moved in the last 12 months: a schedule held, closed or started
--         (EventScheduleOn.HeldOn / ClosedDate / StartDate).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#recent') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #recent;
SELECT DISTINCT e.EventInstanceID INTO #recent FROM #ei e
JOIN EventScheduleOn es ON es.EventInstanceID = e.EventInstanceID
WHERE es.IsDeleted = 0 AND (es.HeldOn >= DATEADD(MONTH, -@DormancyMonths, @AsOf)
OR es.ClosedDate >= DATEADD(MONTH, -@DormancyMonths, @AsOf) OR es.StartDate >= DATEADD(MONTH, -@DormancyMonths, @AsOf));

query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) AS Value FROM #ei;

query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #branch) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) FROM #ei) AS Value;

checks.name: An event type's instances with activity in the last 12 months
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #ei e JOIN #recent r ON r.EventInstanceID = e.EventInstanceID WHERE e.EventID = {RowKey};

checks.name: Different start dates used for an event type
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(StartDate AS DATE)) AS Value FROM #ei WHERE EventID = {RowKey};

checks.tables: Event types in step 2 with nothing in step 3.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM (SELECT e.EventID FROM #ei e LEFT JOIN #recent r ON r.EventInstanceID = e.EventInstanceID
GROUP BY e.EventID HAVING COUNT(r.EventInstanceID) = 0) x;

checks.name: Event types set up in bulk and never used
checks.tables: Event types with 2+ instances, at most 2 different start dates, and nothing in step 3.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM (SELECT e.EventID FROM #ei e LEFT JOIN #recent r ON r.EventInstanceID = e.EventInstanceID
GROUP BY e.EventID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(e.StartDate AS DATE)) <= 2 AND COUNT(r.EventInstanceID) = 0) x;
